integrity: Exact analytic formulas with a reproducible standard-library quadrature and stochastic spot checks; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Focal primary source Maeda is in a proceedings volume with a documented public release on 2008-11-13; this is not a claim about earliest private circulation. Exact dipole law holds for absolute parameter at most one; Fisher statements are local at zero. Uniform baseline already known. Historical priority provisional because Maeda 2008 and Le 1989 complete texts not fully accessible.
title: Exact first-harmonic response of acute spherical triangles
